text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about its risks. One major problem is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair ideas from the data they are given. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups, so fairness must always be a priority. Privacy is another serious concern, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should also be transparent about how their systems work, so people can trust them. Finally, responsible AI development means that governments, scientists and companies must work together to create clear rules that protect everyone.
